headline: Libya Crude Oil Production Crashes by 350,000 BPD Following Pipeline Closures
summary: Libya's oil output dropped by approximately 350,000 barrels per day after an armed group closed a pipeline valve at the Sharara oilfield, the National Oil Corporation said.
why: Libya is an OPEC member with high-quality light sweet crude; unplanned outages directly constrain Mediterranean and global oil balances.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: A 350,000 bpd supply disruption in Libya reduces global crude availability.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The shutdown of Libya's main oilfield pipeline abruptly removed 350,000 barrels per day from global supply.
